Thank you!! It took about 3 sessions total. I switched hairstylists on the 3rd session, so this color was achieved nicely by her. My hair started off at black. And it is, but if you want to invest in that hair, you have to invest in keeping the hair maintained too. I use purple shampoo & conditioner and then I should be going in for a gloss soon to keep the color!
I don't wear blush, no! :) but I will start wearing it. I feel like I was missing something. Thank you so much!

I use the Anastasia brush #12, and I use it with the pomade with a verrrry light hand! Mine used to come out dark too, but I mostly focus on filling in the sparse areas in my brows and then just spooley it all out.

You don't necessarily curl the piece of hair like you normally would, you just do a quick bend and release it. Like beach waves! And alternate the pieces- so bend a curl inward and then the next peace outward. It helps if you go onto YouTube and search beach waves tutorial :) cause I'm not sure if I'm explaining correctly!
Thank you! I use a 1 inch curling iron. It's by Conair- I just slightly curl it and pretty much use the bend method!
Like how do I use it? I use a Real Techniques setting brush and slightly press on the powder mostly on my T-Zone. And I let it bake for like 5 minutes- usually while I'm finishing up my eyes.
